text: {"differences": [{"reason": "English text attributes the submission of questions to \"members of the National Council\" without specifying an organization, while the German text attributes the organization and coordination of the question time to \"SBRG\" (presumably an organization) and states that the SBRG coordinates the answering of the questions.", "type": "meaning_shift", "en": {"quote": "A Federal Council member answers questions submitted in advance by members of the National Council.", "before": "A Federal Council member answers questions submitted in advance by members of the National Council."}, "tgt": {"quote": "Die SBRG organisiert die Arbeiten rund um die Fragestunde und koordiniert die Beantwortung der jährlich durchschnittlich 470 Fragen durch den Bundesrat.", "before": "Die SBRG organisiert die Arbeiten rund um die Fragestunde und koordiniert die Beantwortung der jährlich durchschnittlich 470 Fragen durch den Bundesrat."}, "severity": 0.6}]}
